shadeDescription.text: Peach-nude jelly primer that helps blur pores and the skin's surface before the base step

benefits.text: hince Pore-Shot Blur Primer is a pore-blurring primer with a moist, smooth jelly texture that turns into a fine blur layer when spread on the skin, helping the skin's surface look flatter and smoother, as if filtered. The Micro-Precision Powder System formula combined with the Dura Coat System helps cover large pore areas, texture in the butterfly zone and small pores, while also helping control oil and improve base adhesion. The thin, light jelly-to-blur texture adheres evenly without feeling thick or stifling, helping the cushion/foundation applied afterwards blend in better, slip less and keep makeup fresh for longer. The product has Vegan Certification Completed and has completed primary skin irritation testing and testing on sensitive skin according to brand documents.

howToUse.text: Take a small amount, about 0.5 pump. After skincare and sunscreen, roll/spread a thin layer of product over oil-prone areas with pores, such as the T-zone, around the nose and the butterfly zone. You can layer an extra thin coat on very oily areas to improve base longevity, then continue with cushion or foundation.

safety.text:
For external use only; do not use on damaged skin
Discontinue use if signs of irritation appear, and keep out of reach of children.

positioning.text: Jelly-to-blur primer that helps blur pores, smooth the skin's surface, control oil and improve base longevity in just one step before cushion/foundation.

sellingPoints.text: AI Blur Primer helps skin look smooth, as if filtered; moist, smooth Jelly-to-blur texture that is thin, light and adheres evenly; 24H makeup strong hold, helps improve base longevity by approximately 2X according to brand testing

texture.text: Moist, smooth jelly that turns into a fine blur layer, thin, light, easy to blend.

finish.text: Soft blur / semi-matte smooth / pore-blurring finish.

claimDisclaimers.text: The 100% results are the rate of positive responses at moderate level or above from 20 participants in the brand's test; results may vary depending on skin type and skin condition. The pore area coverage 55%, pore depth coverage 30% and 24H makeup longevity approx 2X improvement claims are based on testing by Probe-M Skin Clinical Research Center during Nov 24–27, 2025. The primary/sensitive skin irritation test in the documents involved 30 adult women; do not interpret it as 100% non-irritating for all skin. Cica Pore Tightening™ should only be described in terms of ingredient properties; do not say it actually treats pores.
